briefdescription.para: Manages attachment of documents/metadata to process instances and linking of process instances to each other.

detaileddescription.para: All data is persisted in the supplied RocksDBWrapper instance.

Key-prefix scheme:
Attachments : proc:attach: <instance_id>:<object_id>
Links : proc:link: <source_id>:<target_id>:<link_type_str>
Required docs: proc:req_doc: <model_id>:<node_id>:<doc_type>

listitem.para: All linking operations are thread-safe and deterministic.
No transactional guarantees across multiple operations; callers must implement their own consistency protocols if needed.
State transitions follow a linear append model: operations are idempotent (reapplying the same link does not change the result).
All retrieval operations (getAttachments, getLinks, etc.) complete within the configured timeout window (see kMaxOperationTimeoutMs in process_common.h).
Maximum retrieval depth for linked hierarchies is bounded by kMaxRetrievalDepth (typically 50).
Accumulated context size during traversal is bounded by kMaxRetrievalContextBytes (typically 1 MiB).
All operations return explicit success/failure indicators (std::pair<bool, string>).
No silent failures; all error conditions are logged and signaled.
Link validation occurs before state commitment (fail-safe).

sect1.title: Threading Guarantees
sect1.para: ProcessLinker is thread-safe. Multiple threads may call any method concurrently provided the underlying RocksDBWrapper is thread-safe (which it is).
